gates_definition.name: Point-in-time integrity
gates_definition.rule: Inputs are strictly pre-kickoff; no result-derived feature; source hashes recorded.

gates_definition.name: Sample size
gates_definition.rule: n >= 1000 settled bets (or the power-analysis minimum, whichever is larger).

gates_definition.name: Out-of-sample
gates_definition.rule: Evaluated on walk-forward seasons never used to fit the model.

gates_definition.name: Significance after multiple testing
gates_definition.rule: Two-sided p < 0.01 AND Benjamini-Hochberg q-value <= 0.10 across all tested strategies.

gates_definition.name: Positive lower bound
gates_definition.rule: Lower 95% bootstrap bound on ROI is above 0.

gates_definition.name: Stability
gates_definition.rule: Profitable in >= 60% of evaluated seasons and no single season > 50% of total profit.

gates_definition.name: Beats the closing line
gates_definition.rule: ROI is measured against the closing line, i.e. it must beat the sharpest public price.

gates_definition.name: Survives luck adjustment
gates_definition.rule: Deflated-Sharpe p < 0.05 given the number of variants tried.

gates_definition.name: Executable
gates_definition.rule: Price, limit and jurisdiction verified for the exact bet and time window.

gates_definition.name: Reproducible
gates_definition.rule: Committed code + data manifest + fixed seed reproduce the published numbers.

demotion_gate.name: Demotion gate (live -> paper)
demotion_gate.rule: A live strategy is demoted to paper immediately when EITHER (a) its rolling window of the last 50 decided bets shows mean closing-line value (CLV) <= 0 - the signal itself has decayed - OR (b) the same rolling window shows flat-stake ROI < -5% - a staking collapse. The gate reads the signal first: condition (a) alone is sufficient, because a lucky staking run must not keep a decayed signal live. Re-promotion requires a full re-qualification (all ten gates re-passed on the merged sample). D1 never uses in-season ROI alone to keep a strategy live.
demotion_gate.thresholds_status: PROPOSED - thresholds (50-bet window, ROI floor -5%, CLV floor 0) are not yet calibrated on live data; D1 is armed but dormant while no strategy is live. Calibration is a prerequisite for the first promotion, not after it.
demotion_gate.data_limitation: CLV requires an opening price and a taken price. The committed feed stores closing-type prices only (opening prices exist for 2021), so condition (a) evaluates only when a bet carries a measured CLV; strategies without opening prices are judged on (b) alone and the gap is disclosed.

leaderboard.ranking_rule: Rank by SIGNAL ONLY: gates passed, then Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted p (lower = stronger skill evidence), then sample size. Staking metrics (ROI and its CI) are reported under `staking` but never affect rank ordering, so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal. A strategy can only earn a reward when all ten gates pass; a positive ROI alone earns nothing.
leaderboard.signal_vs_staking: signal = gates, adjusted significance, win rate, deflated Sharpe, sample size (ordering basis); staking = ROI, ROI CI, units (money outcome only). The split implements the requirement that a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal.

parlay_scoring.note: Parlays are scored on the same gate set with `n` counted as parlays settled. Because leg correlations are measured (correlation.json), a parlay leg set can be priced by copula rather than by multiplication; a parlay strategy that only wins because legs are correlated is a pricing arbitrage, not a forecasting edge, and is labelled as such.

structural_ev.note: EV assumes independent 50/50 legs; correlation moves the true joint probability, not this payout.
